title: Speak the result of queued read commands
test_file_status: planned new file in existing tests/voice lane

evidence.observed: Queue show_pending with a mock pending sample SYNTH-A. The client is called, but the speech callback receives only reconnection/completion messages, never SYNTH-A.

user_impact: A gloved user who asks for pending samples while offline never hears the sample list when connectivity returns.
implementation_scope: Deliver the successful queued command's response to the speech callback, separately from execution and completion bookkeeping. A speech failure must not re-execute a successful mutation or stop processing later commands.
acceptance: A queued show_pending response is spoken once with its sample IDs and count.
Multiple queued reads each deliver their own response in queue order.
A speech callback failure cannot retry a completed server action and does not abandon subsequent queued work.
constraints: Change only the named source file and test file for implementation.
All verification uses synthetic fixtures and mocks; no live SENAITE writes or email.
Do not run jobs sharing a source file as concurrent writers.
duplicate_check: No selected source appears in any of 17 open PR file lists or 32 merged-since-2026-10-09 PR file lists in the saved GitHub snapshot.
